apps.localizedDescription: A private, typed data layer for Apple Shortcuts. Store shared variables, history, navigation, parking, music, Home, and system state on your device.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds English and Spanish app localization, an in-app language selector, the complete bilingual Shortcut collection, Schema 3 import, and automatic timestamps for mode changes.
